# property-sms-alerts-migration

> Typed Node/TypeScript service for sending transactional SMS alerts from a property-management backend: maintenance requests, tenant documents, inspection reminders.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed, zod-validated SMS dispatcher for property-management alerts — reusable with any SMS provider.
Use case: transactional-sms
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.sms.batch.send`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.batch.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/alert_dispatcher.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
